name: Weekend Ritual
source:
Something calls to you from above.

Something sinister. Something ancient. Something evil.

When your friend Liam arrives for a Saturday night sleepover, you've already drawn the circle in the attic... it's just a matter of lighting the candles.

Will you be able to dispel the cursed creature you're about to summon? Or will the vice-like grip of its multiple arms hold you hostage forever?

Why not strike a deal...

Which hand would you like to shake?

[From [url=https://fiendishfiction.itch.io/weekend-ritual]itch.io[/url]]
